name: duopore-public-quoted-total-cost-compare
description: Compare quote totals after adding the line items, shipping, fees and discounts you know about.

interface.longDescription: Compare quote totals after adding the line items, shipping, fees and discounts you know about. Enter quotes for the same work or goods, then add their stated extra costs and discounts. See the maths behind each total. Charges you do not enter are not included. The app does not look up suppliers or check whether the quoted items match; you check that first.
defaultPrompt: Compare these quotes including shipping and stated fees.
Show the full quoted cost from these line items and discounts.

positive.prompt: Use Quoted Total Cost Compare with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"quotes":[{"id":"Q1","shipping":10,"serviceFee":0,"discount":5,"lines":[{"id":"L1","quantity":10,"unitPrice":5}]},{"id":"Q2","shipping":0,"serviceFee":3,"discount":0,"lines":[{"id":"L1","quantity":10,"unitPrice":5}]}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"Lowest listed total 53.","rows":[{"quoteRef":"Q2","lineSubtotal":50,"shipping":0,"serviceFee":3,"discount":0,"lineCount":1,"rank":1,"totalQuotedCost":53,"differenceFromLowest":0},{"quoteRef":"Q1","lineSubtotal":50,"shipping":10,"serviceFee":0,"discount":5,"lineCount":1,"rank":2,"totalQuotedCost":55,"differenceFromLowest":2}],"warnings":["Compare supplied figures in one currency for the same specification. No supplier verification, negotiation, ordering or payment occurs.","Only listed charges are included. Ranking does not establish identical scope, quality, tax treatment or complete commercial terms."]}

review.commerce_description: Free useful computation. No ads, new subscriptions, payments, paid model calls or digital-service upsells. Separate commercial hypotheses are internal planning only.
